Actual one-person serving: cooked wheat ramen noodles 400g, rich cloudy brown-beige pork-bone soy broth about 400ml with finely minced garlic cooked into it and small softened pork-backfat flecks. Standard toppings are a generous but believable mound of fully cooked pale beansprouts 200g and light-green cabbage pieces 80g, plus cooked pork chashu 80g shown as two thick modest slices resting beside the vegetables. Show some thick curled golden noodles visible at the front edge, a low mound of beansprouts and cabbage rising above the broth, two appetising tender chashu slices with lean and fat layers. Keep the proportions as one large personal bowl, not a comedy skyscraper. Garlic is cooked in the broth, NOT a heap of raw garlic topping. No egg, fishcake, menma, nori, spring-onion garnish, corn, sesame, spicy sauce, optional toppings or side dishes. Style: charming contemporary Japanese cookbook illustration, lively coloured-pencil strokes over loose translucent watercolour washes, visible handmade paper texture, warm, gentle and playful but refined, rich natural food colours with delicate coral and sage accents in the ceramic/background. A convincing recognisable finished dish with volume and texture, NOT a pictogram, NOT an SVG icon, NOT flat vector, NOT a photograph. Composition: one full serving viewed from an appetising slightly elevated three-quarter angle, centred, food and the WHOLE vessel fully inside frame with generous clean warm-white paper margins, landscape 4:3 composition, no table props. Background: warm ivory watercolour paper, barely visible pastel wash. No text, labels, lettering, numbers, logo, watermark, cutlery or multiple panels. Keep the illustration beautiful and legible when reduced to a recipe-card thumbnail.
